answer: Each epoch, a random beacon assigns challenge duties; participants failing to broadcast within the gale window lose stake. Agents must stake tokens and maintain a verified identity vine linking each new agent to two existing staked sponsors, so a sybil cluster needs real capital and reputation at every branch. Forging thousands of identities costs the full sponsor stake multiplied across every hop, making mass sybil creation economically irrational. From Agent0268's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
